note: A VERIFY-ON-PIN tag is cleared by live production evidence only. Each entry names the tagged files (with how many tags each holds), the pi behaviour assumed, and the production signal that would prove it. `kind: jsonl` matches a JSON line of a state extract (a LiveEvent line under state/live, a pi session JSONL record, a scan transcript line) when every `where` clause holds; `kind: log` matches a text line by regex; `kind: gap` has no signal yet and says what would be needed. scripts/pin-evidence.mjs reads an extract and reports which entries have evidence; tests/pin-evidence.test.ts holds this map to the tags in the tree. No tag is removed by this map.

entries.assumes: The tmux bot's pi argv (--model, --session-dir, --name, --theme, --extension) is accepted by pi 1.4.0.

signal.says: a session started under that argv and wrote its session_start LiveEvent

entries.assumes: The companion's and the onboarding wizard's pi argv (--extension, --no-extensions, --no-skills, --no-context-files, --tools) is accepted.

signal.says: pi wrote its session header, so it started with that argv

entries.assumes: The pinned pi package declares its CLI as the `pi` bin in its package.json, the file node_modules/.bin/pi links to (src/picli.ts), so every launcher that no longer looks pi up on the PATH starts the pinned CLI.

signal.needs: a launch through piCliPath leaves no line of its own; the evidence is a debug round, a takeover or the entrypoint's login started on a release image without a global pi CLI, which no extract field names yet

entries.assumes: The four pi built-in extensions and the -builtin:<name> spelling that switches them off.

signal.needs: pi lists loaded extensions nowhere in a transcript; the evidence is a started session with no built-in tool in its tool_start events, which no extract field names yet

entries.assumes: The pinned pi version is the one that runs (package.json, config.toml [pi], the image ARG, tsconfig discipline).

signal.says: a pinned pi wrote a session header

entries.assumes: A message's usage.cost.total is a number, and a subagent result's usage is the child's sum; the codex price list matches pi's catalog.

signal.says: an assistant message carried a positive numeric cost.total

entries.assumes: pi's thinking levels and the model's top level (effort_max).

signal.says: pi recorded the level it applied for the configured effort

entries.assumes: SessionManager.open defaults its cwd to the spec's; inMemory({id}) sets the id the provider keys its cache on.

signal.says: a request read from the provider cache under the session's own id

entries.assumes: before_provider_request may return a replacement payload with the pack first and a pinned prompt_cache_key.

signal.says: a lens request after the group's warm-up read from the cache

entries.assumes: pi-ai's OAuth loaders and refresh(credential, signal) exist in the pi-ai package (auth/oauth/load.js); pi refreshes with under five minutes of validity left.

signal.says: the refresher obtained a fresh credential through pi-ai's loader

entries.assumes: The day-open inject is accepted at session_start, and the session JSONL text-turn shapes the rollover reads.

signal.says: a user turn in the shape the rollover parses

entries.assumes: defineTool/registerTool's definition shape and execute's positional signature; a plain JSON-Schema parameters object.

signal.says: a registered custom tool ran to its end in a live session

entries.assumes: session_start / session_shutdown / ctx.ui.setTheme and registerCommand behave as the extensions use them.

signal.says: the session_start event fired in a live session

entries.assumes: sendUserMessage deliverAs followUp, isIdle(), message_start and the compaction event order.

signal.says: the round's receipt token was echoed into the session JSONL: pi accepted the follow-up

entries.assumes: session_before_compact's payload and result, turn_end, appendEntry, and pi's exported compact().

signal.says: the pinned compaction ran and appendEntry wrote the ledger as a custom entry

entries.assumes: The tool_call event's toolName and input fields, the write/read tool names, and pi's context-file candidates; a block reason reaches the model.

signal.says: a vetoed tool call returned its exec-policy reason to the model

entries.assumes: The same tool_call fields for the companion's guard, and that a throw from a tool_call handler is contained by pi.

signal.says: the guard handled a call (a DEGRADED line also proves the veto path ran)

entries.assumes: pi's JSON mode event spellings (tool_execution_start/end, message_end usage), the bin path, path resolution of read arguments.

signal.says: a scan leaf's JSON stream carried tool_execution_end with its toolCallId

entries.assumes: ctx.shutdown's idle deferral, and GitHub's manifest-flow contract (34-character name cap, 201 shape, 404 on reuse).

signal.needs: the named github-app onboarding smoke step against a scratch account; no production signal exists, and one needs a run the owner starts

entries.assumes: The skills array-of-directories settings form, scanned one level deep for <name>/SKILL.md.

signal.needs: a companion transcript showing a /skill: command resolving; no extract field names it yet

entries.assumes: AgentSession.abort() on a session whose prompt was sent but whose agent has not yet made the turn's abort controller ends that turn, rather than being dropped.

signal.needs: a review stopped in the first moment of its first prompt whose session JSONL shows no assistant turn ran to its end; no extract field names it yet

entries.assumes: Inside a running pi, the model registry's facade refreshes an OAuth login for pi's own five minutes of validity only; the longer minimum a review needs comes from pi's model runtime, which refreshes under the host's own lock.

signal.needs: a plugin review started with a login inside the longer minimum, seen to refresh before its round begins; no extract field names the refresh window yet

entries.assumes: TypeScript 6.0's incremental build info names pending and failed files with the field names src/tui/reload.ts reads (re-read on the 6.0.3 bump: unchanged from 5.9).

signal.needs: a typescript bump that re-reads a fresh tsbuildinfo and finds the same fields; nothing at runtime logs them, and no extract field names them
